# SnapReelDownload

SnapReelDownload is a free browser-based video downloader for public social media videos.

## Description
SnapReelDownload helps users save publicly available videos for personal offline viewing. It supports Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X/Twitter, Pinterest, Snapchat, and more. The tool works in a browser with no app install, no account login, and HD MP4/audio options where supported.

## Features
- Browser-based: no APK, extension, or desktop app required.
- No login: no social media username or password required.
- HD quality: MP4 downloads in the best available quality.
- Audio support: MP3/M4A extraction where supported.
- Multi-platform: Instagram Reels, Instagram Stories, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, X/Twitter, Pinterest, and Snapchat.
- Device compatibility: works on iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac, Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge.

## Compliance
SnapReelDownload only supports publicly available content and respects creator privacy settings. It is intended for personal, non-commercial offline viewing. Users should respect copyright law and platform terms.
